about_the_game:
🌌 Step Into the Abyss

Dark Gun is not just another survivor game. It’s a modern roguelite bullet hell where sleek gunplay collides with ancient darkness. One gun. Endless waves. Infinite ways to grow stronger.

The rules are simple: survive, upgrade, and dominate.
The challenge? The night never ends.

⚔️ Features That Hook You Instantly

  • Survivor Action, Reinvented – Pure adrenaline wave survival with the modern edge of tactical gunplay.

  • Guns Meet Dark Magic – Unlock assault rifles, shotguns, cursed pistols, and weapons infused with forbidden power.

  • Endless Enemy Waves – Fight skeletal hordes, armored knights, and nightmare bosses. The longer you last, the deadlier they become.

  • Roguelite Growth – Every run gives new skills, perks, and weapon synergies. Find broken builds, experiment, and outlast the darkness.

  • Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Quit – 10-minute bursts of action that can turn into hours of “just one more run.”

🎮 What Makes Dark Gun Different?

Where other survivor games stop at gimmicks, Dark Gun delivers polished modern graphics, stylish design, and commercial-scale intensity.
It’s built to be the Counter-Strike 2 of survivor roguelites — crisp, modern, instantly viral.

🔥 Built For Millions

Fans of Vampire Survivors, Brotato, and Halls of Torment will feel at home — but with a darker, sharper edge.
If you crave the rush of mowing down hundreds of enemies with guns that glow with forbidden magic, this is the game you’ve been waiting for.

🚀 The Call To Action

Eternal night has fallen. The abyss is watching.
Lock, load, and survive.

✅ Add Dark Gun to your Wishlist now — be there on Day 1.
